title: Sequencing the gaps: dark genomic regions persist in CHM13 despite long-read advances
authors: Wadsworth ME; Page ML; Aguzzoli Heberle B; Miller JB; Steely C; Ebbert MTW
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人类基因组中暗区在长读长测序下的解析，属于基因组测序与比对分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Comprehensive genomic analysis is essential for advancing our understanding of human genetics and disease. However, short-read sequencing technologies are inherently limited in their ability to resolve highly repetitive, structurally complex, and low-mappability genomic regions, previously coined as “dark” regions. Long-read sequencing technologies, such as PacBio and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT), offer improved resolution of these regions, yet they are not perfect. With the advent of the new Telomere-to-Telomere (T2T) CHM13 reference genome, exploring its effect on dark regions is prudent. In this study, we systematically analyze dark regions across four human genome references—HG19, HG38 (with and without alternate contigs), and CHM13—using both short- and long-read sequencing data. We found that dark regions increase as the reference becomes more complete, especially dark-by-MAPQ regions, but that long-read sequencing significantly reduces the number of dark regions in the genome, particularly within gene bodies. However, we identify potential alignment challenges in long-read data, such as centromeric regions. These findings highlight the importance of both reference genome selection and sequencing technology choice in achieving a truly comprehensive genomic analysis.
abstract_zh: 全面的基因组分析对于增进我们对人类遗传学和疾病的理解至关重要。然而，短读长测序技术在解析高度重复、结构复杂及低可比对性基因组区域（此前被称为“暗”区域）方面存在固有局限性。长读长测序技术，如PacBio和Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT)，提高了这些区域的解析度，但仍非完美。随着新的端粒到端粒 (Telomere-to-Telomere, T2T) CHM13参考基因组的问世，探究其对暗区域的影响显得尤为审慎。在本研究中，我们利用短读长和长读长测序数据，系统分析了四个人类基因组参考——HG19、HG38（含或不含替代contigs）及CHM13——中的暗区域。我们发现，随着参考基因组更加完整，暗区域数量增加，尤其是基于MAPQ的暗区域，但长读长测序显著减少了基因组中的暗区域数量，特别是在基因体内。然而，我们识别出长读长数据中潜在的比对挑战，如着丝粒区域。这些发现强调了参考基因组选择和测序技术选择在实现真正全面基因组分析中的重要性。
